DHCPv4::ciaddr
       This command returns ciaddr (client ip address) from DHCPv4 message.

SYNOPSIS
       DHCPv4::ciaddr

DESCRIPTION
       This command returns ciaddr (client ip address) from DHCPv4 message

       Details (syntax): DHCPv4::ciaddr

RETURN VALUE
       This command returns ciaddr (client ip address) from DHCPv4 message

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
	when CLIENT_DATA {
	    log local0. "Ciaddr [DHCPv4::ciaddr]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0
	   --First introduced the command.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
